title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - FileStorageConfiguration
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/FileStorageConfiguration. Represents the attributes that are configurable at service instantiation for storage service offerings. Subclass of StorageConfiguration per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the StorageConfiguration model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FileStorageConfiguration'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

fileSystemType.description: Property. Filesystem type(s) for the storage partition. Controlled-vocabulary value (FileSystemType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

highLevelAccessProtocol.description: Property. Underlying higher-level access protocol(s) (e.g. NFS, CIFS, HDFS). Controlled-vocabulary value (FileAccessProtocol), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
